subject: Marine Works - Construction operations - Richelieu River and Northern Lake Champlain - Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu
text:
Marine Works - Construction operations - Richelieu River and Northern Lake Champlain - Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu
Construction operations taking place during daylight hours on the retaining wall of Royal Military College Saint-Jean at 45 17.919N 073 15.013W beginning 05 Jan 2026. Turbidity curtains, cofferdams and a barge may be present.
